description: Taxable Social Security benefits calculator — How much of a person's Social Security benefits is federally taxable (IRS Pub 915 worksheet, offline): provisional income, 0%/50%/85% tier, taxable and non-taxable amounts, the marginal 'tax torpedo' inclusion rate per extra dollar of income, and the 2025-2028 age-65+ senior deduction estimate. Required: benefits (annual SSA-1099 box 5). Optional: other_income (AGI excluding Social Security), tax_exempt_interest, filing (single|mfj|mfs|hoh|qss), lived_with_spouse (for mfs), age65 (0-2). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_ss_taxable
